c2d049f1941b.title: Founder Associate Intern
c2d049f1941b.description_html:
About the Role

Work closely with a founding team at an AI-enabled recruiting startup to help connect ambitious candidates with career opportunities at venture-backed startups. This role supports the candidate experience and helps improve the workflows behind talent matching.

What You'll Do

  • Support candidates through the talent-matching process and help connect them with relevant startup opportunities.

  • Manage candidate relationships and contribute to a thoughtful, high-quality candidate experience.

  • Take ownership of operational workflows and identify ways to improve or automate processes.

  • Contribute to recruiting, talent acquisition, and social media initiatives as needed.

What We're Looking For

  • Zero to four years of experience, including at least three months of internship experience and experience in a company setting.

  • A completed bachelor's degree and evidence of strong academic performance, substantial projects, or relevant contributions.

  • Experience in a fast-paced environment such as a startup, consulting, sales, or venture capital.

  • Familiarity with venture-backed startups and hiring practices; recruiting, candidate relations, workflow automation, or social media experience is helpful.

  • Willingness to relocate to San Francisco and commit to a six-day work week for the internship.

Compensation & Benefits

Visa sponsorship is available.

Location

On-site in San Francisco, California.
